map.费用率是综合成本率的组成部分（赔付率加费用率等于综合成本率）。费用率长期大于20: The expense ratio is a component of the combined ratio (loss ratio + expense ratio = combined ratio). A persistently >20% expense ratio usually squeezes underwriting profit and needs scale or digitalization to cut cost.
map.保险费用率：费用率 = 营运费用 ÷ 保费收入 × 100（%）；联动量：保费费: Expense ratio: expense ratio = operating expenses ÷ premium income × 100 (%); linked values: premium to expense ratio = premium ÷ operating expenses (undefined when expenses are 0, shown as —), difference = premium income − operating expenses (CNY), expense ratio as a decimal = expenses ÷ premium income. Validation: both fields are required valid numbers; operating expenses must be ≥ 0 and premium income > 0 (premium is the denominator of every division on this page), otherwise a prompt stops the run and no detail table, history entry or export is produced. Rule: no fixed grading; the lower the expense ratio, the more efficiently premium income is used for claims and operations. The 10⁻⁹ denominator fallback has been removed: a negative expense used to yield a premium-to-expense ratio on the order of 1e16, pointing the opposite way from the negative expense ratio.
